scope:
Bounded original Wii drag/radial/vortex force-kernel instruction reference.

Executes the unattenuated/no-distance-limit cases and their original vector
helpers. Prepared field transforms and input particle streams are supplied.
Does not execute model/field updates, RNG, allocation or the world scheduler.
Finite normal fixtures only; FPSCR exceptions/NI subnormal modes are not modeled.
